Electrical subcontract · Project overview
Riverside Office Renovation. Customer: Northline Builders. Contractor: Summit Electrical.
Agreement date: September 28, 2026. Signed by both parties.
Agreed contract value: $125,000. Project dates: Oct 5 – Nov 20, 2026.
Electrical fit-out under drawing E-101 Rev A, with scope and pricing exhibits incorporated.
Payment terms: monthly progress billing, payable within 30 days of invoice.
Retainage: 5% of each progress billing is withheld until final completion and acceptance.
Exhibit A · Included scope
Supply and install 48 outlets at the locations shown on E-101 Rev A.
Supply and install 24 LED fixtures.
Six branch circuits included in the signed scope.
Complete testing and labeling of installed circuits.
Exhibit A · Exclusions and changes
Weekend installation excluded.
Modifications to existing service equipment excluded.
Additional work and proposed pricing are subject to the contractual change and approval procedure.
